newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - July 16.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - July 16.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker levels held steady on Wednesday as improved enquiries offset impact from a weak cargo market, traders said. News that Indonesian authorities boarded several tankers refuelling outside Singapore port limits improved the buying interest within the Singapore port limits, they said. However, traders did not expect major gains in bunker levels, noting losses in the cargo market. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870-3571)
